correctness.rationale: A nonzero 3x4 kernel dependency can be made nonnegative by sign flips, orienting the generators with 0 in their tetrahedral hull. Tetrahedral dissection gives zonotope volume as one tetrahedron determinant; the three balanced signed sums w_j have det four times the volume. All balanced half-sums are vertices/candidates of the centered zonotope and have norm <=R. Hadamard forces three w_j perpendicular and of length 2R at equality. Inverting the 3x4 Walsh transform gives p_i=q_i+v and the positivity condition -v in T_R. The other signed sums exhaust the circumradius: 2v, three balanced R terms, and v-q_i, yielding exactly the region constraints, necessary and sufficient even at degeneracies. Independent exact rational witness at R=2,v=(1/10,0,0) has V=16, R^2=4, unequal generator squared lengths 281/100 and 321/100. The open interior of Omega_R shows genuinely nonregular equality. The witness proves existence, while general necessity/sufficiency follows algebraically.

value.rationale: This fully resolves the equality classification for an extremal sharp inequality and answers the explicitly posed regularity question by constructing nonregular optimizers, with a precise semialgebraic parameter locus including boundary configurations. final_claim: For full-dimensional spatial zonotopes with <=4 segment generators, volume=2R^3 iff, after generator signs, translation and rigid motion, p_i=q_i+v with q_i a regular tetrahedron at scale R/2 and v satisfying -v in conv(q_i), 2||v||<=R and ||v-q_i||<=R for i=1..4; a nonempty open 3-parameter nonregular rhombic-dodecahedral equality family exists.
limitations: Dimension exactly three, full-dimensional bodies with at most four generators; no higher dimensions, no stability estimate; parameterization has finite congruence redundancies.
